arcs.title: The Duck Waits
arcs.summary: Day 2: The orange duck has been found to bear the numeral 7 stamped beneath its left wing — clean, precise, aged about a week. Survey marker 7 sits on the Harlan's Creek tributary grid, forty yards below Christine's crossing line. The alignment may be coincidental; no one believes it is. Lucy circled the Jeep twice and sat facing the road for eleven minutes. The Ministry subcommittee has claimed jurisdiction over the numeral by internal motion, which is not how jurisdiction works. The forty-seven-degree angle between ducks is unchanged. Day 3 should produce either a glimpse of the Bandit — a figure seen at the edge of the drive, a second token left near the Jeep, or a connection established between the numeral 7 and someone who was known to be near the creek on the morning of the first — or a second stamped numeral, somewhere unexpected, deepening the trail.
